prompt: Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. MEDIUM reference: an elegant observational picture-book drawing with a clear coherent silhouette, 6–10 separated distinguishing structural details and natural joined parts. Richer form than an icon, without intricate texture or dense repeated marks. One elegant violin in three-quarter view resting diagonally, visible scroll, bridge, four strings and one separate bow beside it, minimal fine details. Essential rendering rule: flat OUTLINE ART for a child's tracing activity. Pure white interiors and pure white background; ONLY dark ink contour strokes. No gray gradients, shadows, dense hatching, hair strands, woodgrain or fine textures. Whole composition comfortably inside the square with clear margins. Draw only the specified subject, no unrelated additional toys, animals or people. If beginner, the fewest essential large forms; if medium, a few thoughtful structural details.
